title: Copilot Studio: makers can require human approval before an agent runs a tool
summary: Hold: the briefing labels the new approval control as maker opt-in while its rationale says the default is not stated, and the sources do not establish its initial enforcement state. The roadmap facts and existing control paths are supported, but the explanation of session-wide approval goes beyond the published description.

claims.fix: Set defaultState to "unknown" to agree with the rationale. For a new control the standard requires its initial enforcement state, which the roadmap does not state; the existing standard-harness setting's No default does not establish this toggle's default. Keep the maker-configuration fact separately.

claims.claim: Approve for the session covers repeated calls to the same tool for the rest of that session.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot Studio" "approve for the session"; site:learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio "approval" "tool" "session". Read roadmap and cited tool pages. The roadmap names the option but does not define its scope; Cowork examples describe a different feature.
